3b54f81a:  ;
 ;This tag processes the user's request for help.  If the user
 ;entered a '?', the help text is displayed.  If the call originated
 ;from the main option, the text contained in the ENHLPTXT, DLHLPTXT,
 ;CEHLPTXT, VWHLPTXT or ADHLPTXT arrays is displayed.  If the call
 ;originated from a child option, the text in the CIHLPTXT array is
 ;displayed.
 ;
